title: Grokui, the Slumbering Basilisk
summary: Prepare for Grokui to replenish his health repeatedly while gaining melee strength.
overview: Prepare for Grokui to replenish his health repeatedly while gaining melee strength.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Save healing resources and defensive coverage for the later, stronger cycles.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% and 10% health, Grokui sets his current health to 430,000 and raises his minimum and maximum melee hits.
The health resets make the fight longer than one health bar suggests.
Leaving combat returns him to full health and restores the opening melee tuning.

notes: Approval E403. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The script sets 430,000 current HP rather than using GetMaxHP; compare the deployed NPC max health before describing each transition as a full heal.
Resolve the exact NPC template IDs from the zone database before enabling NPC-page links.
